title: agathosma ciliaris
intro: Agathosma ciliaris, commonly known as the 'Round Leaved Barrenwort', is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Agathosma ciliaris include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activities, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are primarily attributed to the presence of limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which work in synergy to provide the plant's therapeutic effects.
